additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422610-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multiple] IP Address Configuration CRM:02679000230
additional_info.body:
Hello Matteo,
Before we start the configuration change of IP address on the shared charger, I would like to clarify few points here, though you have discussed this with Shrey, still need to be sure that the suggested configuration change request it correct
The WAN IP address needs to be applied for which router,
XF3 (Siemens) or XF4 (Customer/OCPP)
?
If it is for XF3, I hope you understand the risk of few chargers going offline during the configuration change?
After the configuration change, do we need to set the WAN/Ethernet as the primary and SIM card as secondary or vice versa?
Do all chargers have the ethernet cable installed, connected and configured from customer end?
Based on your confirmation, we will begin the activity, please note that the configuration change can be made by remote SSH connection, hence applying configuration change on all charger's between 08:00 - 10:30 AM CEST, in a single day is not achievable due to the number of chargers and the limited resource available over the time. It can take 2-3 days to complete the activity; hope you are okay with it?
Here you can track the status of configuration change
EUROSISTEMI_IP_Configuration.xlsx.
Looking forward to have your prompt response.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
